boundaries: PCA is production tooling and does not become canonical gameplay/narrative/World/Character state authority
all imported/generated media resources register through ARI identity/provenance/rights rules
procedural suitability/proposal never silently becomes canonical distribution or World truth
PCA character tooling cannot invent anatomy, Form, equipment ownership or Character mechanics
AAI retains audio cue/soundscape semantics and DWC retains constructed-language pronunciation authority
CNI retains content/narrative runtime; PCA-10 is an authoring workbench over CNI
Action/Event/APM/SMB-12 retain AI and canonical mutation authority; PCA-11 cannot grant unrestricted NPC/GM actions
SMB-13/BRP retain external tester/product-readiness authority; PCA-14 is internal only
PCA-15 does not implement a replacement VCS
MCS is the strict planned successor after PCA-16 and consumes PCA production/generator primitives without making PCA a cartography owner
MCCS is a downstream consumer of PCA-05/PCA-06/PCA-09/PCA-15 capabilities for creator-facing Character/creature workflows and does not make PCA an appearance or entity owner
commercial/open-source direct dependencies require separate current rights/license review
no implementation authority until separately governed start
